There's no need to wait for the colonel.
I'll shoot you down myself!

that's been giving Todd trouble is back.

but shooting it down myself...

{C:8193CD02}{C:819582965F3300000000}Well, you knooow,
Ed is Ed.

{C:8193A302}{C:81958296603300000000}That's not what I mean.
You don't understand
what I'm saying.

{C:8193CD02}{C:81958296613300000000}Eheh heh heh heh heh!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296A53300000000}Keen!
Don't leave the tools lying around!

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296A63300000000}Oh, soooorry!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A83300000000}Nie's in a bad mood, isn't he?

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296A93300000000}It looks like he's remembering
how he failed to rescue Riml.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AA3300000000}That happened?


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81931D00}{C:81958296AC3300000000}Apparently, Riml's mother, {C:819782830400}Louser{C:819782830000}, held a knife to Riml
and threatened
Nie.

{C:81933400}{C:81958296AD3300000000}If you don't leave, I'll stab her in the eye, then kill her!

{C:81931D00}{C:81958296AE3300000000}That's what she said, apparently.
What a complicated mother and daughter.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AF3300000000}So that's what happened.


{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B13300000000}You're kind, Keen.
All right, I'll forget what just happened.

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296B23300000000}You're a good person, too.
Thank you.

rows.en:
{C:81933302}{C:81958296B83300000000}It's amazing, isn't it?
A world with fairies.

{C:81931B00}{C:81958296B93300000000}There are lots in my world.
It's perfectly normal.

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296BA3300000000}The place I was in had
lots of even stranger things.
So I'm not all that surprised.

{C:81931B00}{C:81958296BB3300000000}What do you mean, even stranger!?

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296BC3300000000}Oh, sorry!
I didn't mean you're strange, Chum.

{C:81933302}{C:81958296BD3300000000}Wow!
Then I'd like to go
where you were, too, Wataru.

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296BE3300000000}Come and visit sometime.

{C:81933302}{C:81958296BF3300000000}I will!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C03300000000}Hey, Wataru, Yuu.
Could you give me a hand?

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296C13300000000}Yeees!

{C:81933302}{C:81958296C23300000000}We're coming!!



{x00}

{C:8190C302}{C:81958296E23300000000}That's amazing.
I've gained a little respect for you.

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296E33300000000}You're physically strong.
{C:819782830400}Toya{C:819782830000}, you can do it too, with the right mindset.
That goes for Kira, of course.

{C:8190C402}{C:81958296E63300000000}Yes, Domon!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296E73300000000}Hey!
Would you like to train with us, too?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E83300000000}I'll pass.
If I tried to keep up with everyone,
I'd wreck my body.

{C:81935300}{C:81958296692F00000000}So this is a Brain's cockpit.
I can feel similarities to an HM
all over the place.

{C:8193A002}{C:819582966A2F00000000}Really?
I'm no good with machinery.

{C:81935300}{C:819582966B2F00000000}Then how do you manage to pilot a Brain?

{C:8193A002}{C:819582966C2F00000000}A Brain is, well,
something like a child.
So it doesn't really feel like piloting.

{C:81935300}{C:819582966D2F00000000}Oh, I see.
That's interesting.

{C:81930100}{C:819582966E2F00000000}Oh, what are you two doing?


{x00}

{C:81905300}{C:819582966F2F00000000}It feels a bit similar,
so I was being shown
the Brain's cockpit.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296702F00000000}Similar to an HM?
I can't see it.

{C:81958296712F00000000}I think the new FT I was shown earlier
is much more similar.


{C:81905300}{C:81958296722F00000000}Of course they're different.
A Brain is alive, after all.
Right, You?

{C:8190A002}{C:81958296732F00000000}Yes. They even have emotions.


{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296752F00000000}That makes me happy.
Thank you, Brain.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190A102}{C:81958296772F00000000}That's why these little ones can fight.
They don't really want to fight.
Brains are afraid of battle.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296782F00000000}Of battle?

{C:8190A102}{C:81958296792F00000000}Yes, just like people.
But they want to protect the continent and everyone,
so they fight for us.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967A2F00000000}I'll take that to heart.

{C:8190A102}{C:819582967B2F00000000}You're a good kid.
That's why the Brains like you.
Let's do our best together.

{C:81900200}{C:819582967D2F00000000}Oh, we'd better be going.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967E2F00000000}Right.
We're going out for a bit.

{C:8193A102}{C:819582967F2F00000000}Have a nice triiip!
Bring back souveniiirs!



{x00}
